ports.note: Two ports, Table (`records`) and Polygon summaries (`polygons`), named the same on the canvas and in the Inspector (src/port-names.ts). The `series` port is retired: a workflow saved with it opens with the edge on Table and its inputMode removed (src/core.ts#migrateChartSeriesPort), and a case series on Table draws the same curve with the same receipt, its period and kind of date.

ontology.note: Existing ontology alignment; full configuration and port shape contracts remain to be defined. The transmission tree asserts fw:TransmissionTree with its columns and counts, declared in ontology/runtime.ttl; listed here as none because this widget is defined in core.ts#TYPES, which the coupling check cannot attribute.

changes.description: A column is named with its confirmed label beside it, in the axis title and the caption: "신고 주차 (Week of report)"; never in its place. The source line in Notes and in the downloaded SVG names the step, not its id. The practitioner, 2026-11-14: "This Chart has koren. And we do not have translation capability (yet)."
